spec_features.spec_quote: Set max_turns=50 as hard limit per task.
spec_features.evidence: task_harness.py:579-582 is_complete() returns True when self.turn >= 50 (hardcoded literal 50). experiment.py:158 `while not env.is_complete()` honors it, terminating the interaction loop. NOTE: the cap is the hardcoded literal 50, not config.max_turns (TaskEnvironment.__init__ at task_harness.py:519 takes only `task` and never reads config.max_turns=50 from config.py:28). FeedbackGenerator has its own max_turns=50 default (task_harness.py:319). The cap is still genuinely enforced and breaks the loop.
spec_features.notes: Enforced via hardcoded 50, not the config field; config.max_turns is effectively unused but a 50-turn cap does run and stop the loop.

spec_features.feature_name: early stop when all tests pass
spec_features.spec_quote: Early stopping (if all tests pass) - Implemented: task completes if all tests pass before turn 50
spec_features.evidence: task_harness.py:583-585 is_complete() returns all(last_results.values()); experiment.py:158 loop exits when it returns True. Reachable: e.g. _feedback_type_mismatch returns all-True for turn<=6 (task_harness.py) and _feedback_regression returns all-True for turn<=15, so the all-pass condition can fire and break the loop.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely wired and reachable; terminates the loop.
